mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_account( member_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_num, account_name, balance, fintech_use_num ) VALUES( #{memberId}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{accountNum}, #{accountName}, #{balance}, #{fintechUseNum} )
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, member_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_num, account_name, balance, created_at, fintech_use_num FROM bank_account WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT account_id, member_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_num, account_name, balance, created_at, fintech_use_num FROM bank_account WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT account_id, member_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_num, account_name, balance, created_at, fintech_use_num FROM bank_account WHERE account_num = #{accountNum}
